title: feat(mix16): fourteen mixed shells on B16; t=8 and t=14 stay mixed
science: Extends the isochrone/mixed-shell classification (#6732 on B_8, #6752 on B_12) to B_16(0): fourteen mixed t-shells with full radius lists and site counts. The load-bearing trend, visible in its own table, is that mixing GROWS with t (2 radii at t=5 up to 29 radii at t=18) -- the nu isochrones get further from spheres at larger radius, not closer. That is a negative for any continuum-isotropy recovery from this hop-cost, and it is the same shell in which both reverse-critical diagonals (2,2,2) at t=8 and (4,4,4) at t=14 sit.
verdict_pair: reverse=absent face=absent (reports 14 mixed shells; t8_mixed True, t14_mixed True)
